title: Hyperqube
tagline: Generates a programmable NFT as digital twin based on health care parameters and personal birth chart date to provide an personalized astrological hero journey.
description:
A decentralized Augmented Reality game app built on NFT digital twin ZK-ID technology as a private key to access a social network for real life matchmaking experiences with geolocation. To provide motivation through discipline with daily meditations as tasks to unlock personal behavior patterns as a way to meet new compatible gamers. 

Taking time date and place birth from the user also daily habits input from the cell phone sensors. 

The App are able to generates 4096 kinds of parameterizable NFT with 64 page history telling synthesized in an unique piece of art that contains visual information about an 12 steps astrological hero journey through 9 planets aspects with an 36 collective pathways in a 24 hours challenge game loop that aims to match compatible player based on the calculation of 384 kinds of moods 192 kinds of emotions through 6 astrological transits and three simple rules: 

Mint superpowers, Match our profile with another players and Monetize you data.

The vision is:
Create an Hypergraph social network based on "Hypergram" score that contains personal information in a Hypercubic data structure where people can Play by minting superpowers, match your archetype with another players and monetize their data as a custom ticket for access exclusive events.

The inspiration:
From the past four years I have been traveling around the world in search to combine ancient knowledge with modern technologies in which I found in the I-ching the more comprehensive way to combine the human and technology aspects. 
While I was traveling I learn to use the oracle as a way to play with decisions in the real life and since than I`be working to translate this life experience in a game mechanics. 
Right now I am combine my studies in Chinese Medicine and Biomedical Engineering to provide an physiological serious game service.

The motivation:
Synthesize in a unique piece of art information about the human behavior that combines health care parameters and astrological archetypes  classification in a way to connects heath care data with the Chinese Meridian Human system in geometrically data structure that contains a pathway to learn more about those patters in a gamified hero journey.
